anchor.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $F$
where $U^{\perp}$ is the set of vectors orthogonal to every vector of $U$
the labels $U$ and $V$ are its smaller and larger label
Its orthogonal residual is $R = V\cap U^{\perp}$

gaps.term: dimension of the residual for a nondegenerate subspace
gaps.quote: Since $U$ is nondegenerate, $\dim R = \dim V-\dim U$
gaps.note: The reader cannot check this from the page. It needs that a nondegenerate subspace splits the space as U plus its orthogonal complement, so that V = U plus (V ∩ U^⊥), which the page does not give.
